# wordcell

> A local knowledge base for coding agents. Save decisions in Markdown, find
> the notes behind a code change, and give the next session only the context
> it needs. Exact search and graph queries run locally without an account or
> model. Web capture, optional remote reranking, and hosted agents have separate
> data-handling boundaries.

When to use this site:
- Use wordcell.io to learn what Wordcell is, the boundaries it keeps, and the
  current verified install command.
- Use /docs for the complete README: installation, vault format, command
  surface, capture, graph, skills, and release notes.

## Pages

- [Wordcell](https://wordcell.io/): Quick start, measured context payloads, comparisons,
  selected-note publishing, local-data boundaries, and the verified install.
- [Documentation](https://wordcell.io/docs): The complete Wordcell README
  rendered as a page, including the install reference.
